name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v527: Fixed Cloudflare bypass not solving - WebView now reads document.cookie directly via JavaScript evaluateJavascript() in addition to CookieManager, so JS-set cf_clearance cookies are detected. Uses raw WebView User-Agent (no aggressive cleaning that Cloudflare fingerprints as suspicious). Harvests cookies from www. subdomains too. Re-checks for clearance 3s after page load to catch async cookie setting. All v526 features retained: truly invisible WebView toggle, cookie freshness check (~30 min) on app open, probe throttle once per minute, skip probe when cookie fresh, stream-link cache ~20 min, one canonical AnimePahe domain.
